import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Set style
plt.style.use('seaborn-v0_8-whitegrid')
sns.set_palette("husl")

# Create figure with subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(18, 12))

# 1. Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep by BMI Category
ax1 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 1)
scatter = sns.scatterplot(data=df, x='Sleep Duration', y='Quality of Sleep', 
                         hue='BMI Category', s=80, alpha=0.7, ax=ax1)
ax1.set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality by BMI Category', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=12)
ax1.legend(title='BMI Category', title_fontsize=10, fontsize=9)

# 2. Average Sleep Metrics by Occupation
ax2 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 2)
occupation_metrics = df.groupby('Occupation').agg({
    'Sleep Duration': 'mean',
    'Quality of Sleep': 'mean',
    'Stress Level': 'mean'
}).sort_values('Sleep Duration', ascending=False)

x = np.arange(len(occupation_metrics))
width = 0.25
ax2.bar(x - width, occupation_metrics['Sleep Duration'], width, label='Sleep Duration', alpha=0.8)
ax2.bar(x, occupation_metrics['Quality of Sleep'], width, label='Quality of Sleep', alpha=0.8)
ax2.bar(x + width, occupation_metrics['Stress Level'], width, label='Stress Level', alpha=0.8)

ax2.set_xlabel('Occupation', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_ylabel('Average Score', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_title('Average Sleep Metrics by Occupation', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=12)
ax2.set_xticks(x)
ax2.set_xticklabels(occupation_metrics.index, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=9)
ax2.legend(fontsize=9)

# 3. Distribution of Sleep Duration by Gender and Sleep Disorder
ax3 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 3)
df['Sleep Disorder'] = df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None')
box_data = df[df['Sleep Disorder'].isin(['None', 'Sleep Apnea', 'Insomnia'])]
sns.boxplot(data=box_data, x='Sleep Disorder', y='Sleep Duration', hue='Gender', 
            ax=ax3, width=0.7, fliersize=3)
ax3.set_xlabel('Sleep Disorder', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_ylabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_title('Sleep Duration Distribution by Disorder and Gender', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=12)
ax3.legend(title='Gender', title_fontsize=10, fontsize=9)

# 4. Correlation Heatmap of Numerical Variables
ax4 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 4)
numerical_cols = ['Age', 'Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep', 'Physical Activity Level', 
                  'Stress Level', 'Heart Rate', 'Daily Steps']
corr_matrix = df[numerical_cols].corr()
mask = np.triu(np.ones_like(corr_matrix, dtype=bool))
sns.heatmap(corr_matrix, mask=mask, annot=True, fmt='.2f', cmap='coolwarm', 
            center=0, square=True, linewidths=1, cbar_kws={"shrink": 0.8}, ax=ax4)
ax4.set_title('Correlation Between Health Metrics', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=12)

# 5. Physical Activity vs Stress Level by Age Group
ax5 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 5)
df['Age Group'] = pd.cut(df['Age'], bins=[15, 30, 45, 60, 100], 
                         labels=['18-30', '31-45', '46-60', '60+'])
scatter2 = sns.scatterplot(data=df, x='Physical Activity Level', y='Stress Level', 
                          hue='Age Group', size='Quality of Sleep', sizes=(30, 150), 
                          alpha=0.7, ax=ax5)
ax5.set_xlabel('Physical Activity Level', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_ylabel('Stress Level', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_title('Physical Activity vs Stress Level by Age Group', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=12)
ax5.legend(title='Age Group', title_fontsize=10, fontsize=9, loc='upper right')

# 6. Daily Steps Distribution by BMI Category
ax6 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 6)
violin_data = df[df['BMI Category'].isin(['Normal', 'Overweight', 'Obese'])]
sns.violinplot(data=violin_data, x='BMI Category', y='Daily Steps', 
               inner='quartile', palette='Set2', ax=ax6)
sns.stripplot(data=violin_data, x='BMI Category', y='Daily Steps', 
              color='black', alpha=0.3, size=2, jitter=True, ax=ax6)
ax6.set_xlabel('BMI Category', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_ylabel('Daily Steps', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_title('Daily Steps Distribution by BMI Category', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=12)

# Adjust layout and save
plt.suptitle('Sleep Health & Lifestyle Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150, facecolor='white')
plt.close()
